standard-dialogue.player: Hello there, what do you do here?

standard-dialogue.npc: Hi. We are in charge of this practice area.
Surrounding us are four towers. Each tower contains trained archers of a different level. You'll notice it's quite a distance, so you'll need a longbow.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player's Ranged level is 50 or lower:

steps.npc: As you're not very skilled, so I advise you to practise on the north tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player's Ranged level is between 51 and 60:

steps.npc: You seem to have some skill, so I advise you to practice on the east tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player's Ranged level is between 61 and 70:

steps.npc: You appear to be fairly skilled with a bow, so I advise you to practice on the south tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player's Ranged level is 71 or higher:

steps.npc: Looks like you're very skilled, so I advise you to practice on the west tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.

overhead-dialogue-when-climbing-up-the-c.npc: The [north/east/south/west] tower is occupied, get them!

overhead-dialogue-when-a-tower-s-archers.npc: The [north/east/south/west] tower has received reinforcements, kill them quickly!
